title: Black Pudding Crostini
description: A rich and savory appetizer featuring black pudding, crunchy accompaniments, and a tangy glaze.

ingredients.name: crunch
ingredients.notes: such as chopped nuts or crackers

instructions: 1. Slice the black pudding into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
2. Arrange the rounds on a baking sheet lined with parchment.
3. Drizzle with kurokuzu and black vinegar.
4. Broil in the oven until lightly caramelized.
5. Meanwhile, chop the crunch into smaller pieces.
6. Assemble the crostini by placing a round of black pudding on each plate.
7. Top with a spoonful of crunch.
